book.name: Ioanes
book.title: Bais ula mumuru la omirong Ioanes aime Iesu

content: Gas o magabun la okiraraieng magi
Urie, Iesu la ula bo pugama Oliva.
Urie, parabira namur, inagat ula na luguan o lotu. Ga papot teip ga magaulap la mumaio mepto ties ang. Are ratmat ga ula unama ga man masinguala.
Na tara la man tiesong Iesu, teip mila o it maset maimai ga gar ma Parasaiop la maialo non magabun non garip la ogimameng la okiraraieng magi. Are ratmat ga merilio uriro magabun kabirana ma.
Ga amelo Iesu gare ro, “Migana o usingnualap, uriro magabun la okiraraieng magi ga ogimameng.
Na maimai buong, Moses la tiesong gare ro, ‘Ovurebuong magabun are riro a tadas ga iving.’ Pa tiesnung gare mani?”
Tiesmeng gare tiro muana la namo avanameng meba aramang ties ba ula kiro meba maiabung na ties. Pa man kumuong Iesu me lourup ga man umirong na kimanam o kanevunam a.
Man amarikmeng ga man amarikmeng, pa dusong ga maulo, “Aga migana kabirana mi la tale amaning kirinim, tie lake obaleang uriro magabun a natauan tandas ga iving.”
Tiesong gare tiro, tie inagat kumuong ga umirong na kimanam.

Teip mila kakanim la mepto uriro ties ga mirier ganam ut narit narit la mulimeba ga miura me lavie. Teip mila uke la mela lake, pa mirie non la meuluo. Iesu iriet narit la unama ga magabun la man dusieng ka.
Urie, dusong Iesu ga omarikong uriro magabun, “Magabun, lagim inamaniap? Atabo karuk kan a noba migana la nouabu na ties me uriro kirinim, a?”
Igama magabun, “Ila Kakani, karuk kan a noba.” Pa oulo Iesu, “Turuo gat la tale kan noruabu na ties. Nala ra ga tubiat baraba gat okosarnung kirinim.”
Iesu la ugama, “Turuo lalabie onim na kimanam.”

Uriro magabun la ila ra. Tie, Iesu la inagat maulo teip ga magaulap, “Turuo lalabie onim na kimanam. Man migana la upto ties tung ga touluo, eba tale amung na arubu pa eba amaning lalabie o ninimiap.”
Parasaiop la mepto uriro ties ang, are ratmat ga abukmela gare ro, “Baisnung kan me nulam. Are ratmat ga baisiap nuam la tale kan migat ma.”

Pa upulo Iesu ties maiong ga ugama, “Migat, bais tung kan me rulam. Pa tale kan tokarabi. Tiestung la migat o. Memani, orit pianam la teruara una ga muruo. Ga are gat to, orit pianam la tuga tala una. Pa mimi la tale amit muana o pianam tung. Ga eba tala lagum, uriro gat ga tale omit.
Mimi la mimet mavuvuo inamaniap a tavuk onim na kimanam. Pa tale kan tume avuvuo migana ba.
Pa leba avuvuorang migana, eba avuvuorang puvut. Memani, talet turuo talamet la avuvurung. Karuk. Mamo la tosagaong ga muruo, irie la ubiong ga turuo.
Na maimai ang Moses omiuluo ties la iot gare ro, ‘Leba narain ba teivien la baisliong o namurit ties, tie baisliong ga migat o.’
Tie, turuo kan la tume bais me rulam kan, ga Mamo la tosagaong ga muruo, irie gat la ume bais me rulam.”
Pa amarikmeng gare ro, “Lagi Mamo nuang?” Upulo Iesu ties maiong gare ro, “Tale tomit ga tale kan amit Mamo ruang. La tomit, tie eba amira Mamo ruang.”

Iesu la uaramam miriro tiesiap na kabin la mime mumaio miabu inamaniap kamniap ana, na tara la masinguala teip ga magaulap na luguan o lotu. Are ratmat ga karuk kan a migana ba la uat a ga avisang. Memani, tara ang me nuvarap la tale ka betong.
Tale kan puoming meba mila na pianam la eba tala una
Tie, inagat maulo Iesu Parasaiop gare ro, “Eba tala ga tala gat puoming meba tomioping. Ga eba man miving pa kirinim ming la eba kan man iot. Tale kan puoming meba mila na pianam la eba tala una.”
Are ratmat ga teip mila uke onim Iudaia la nemarikmeng kabirana ma, “Memani ga tiesong tale kan puoming meba mila na pianam leba tala una? Atabo eba teanamung ga aving, a?”
Pa maulo Iesu gare ro, “Mimi onim to lourup. Pa turuo onim nakap. Mimi onim na uro kimanam. Pa tale kan turuo onim na uro kimanam.
Are ratmat ga mirulo, eba miving, ga eba ka man iot kirinim ming. Leba tale naganming ira iriro migana la miulo, tie eba miving ga eba ka iot kirinim ming.”
Pa amarikmeng Parasaiop, “Tie, panalava nunuo aga!” Pa ugama Iesu, “Turuot iriro migana, are tinan la mirulor.

Matim papot ma tiesiap la tuga taramam a tavuk ming, ga eba avuvuorang tavuk ming are migana o ukosar o ties. Are ratmat ga irie la tosagaong ga muruo, tavuk ang la migat a. Pa mirier tiesiap la tume tuptam aun, miriet la tume tuaramam mai teip ga magaulap onim na kimanam.”
Pa tale kan ameit la maulo a Mamo.

Pa ugama Iesu maime, “Tubiat eba maiaving Poi ang migana. Na irie tara bat eba tomira, turuo irie migana. Ga eba tomira, tale kan akosartung paga ba o agat kan tung, karuk. Tume tuaramo ties are Mamo la tosinguala o.
Mamo la tosagaong ga muruo, irie la unama ga turuo. Tale kan toulai, meba turuo bat talamet le tonang. Karuk. Memani, busit la tume makosar pagap Mamo kan la naong maime.”
Tiesong gare tiro ga papot teip ga magaulap la naganmeng ira a.
Ties migat la eba mikosarieng ga betming ga uakap ba ira mi
Are ratmat ga maulo Iesu Iudaiap mirie mila naganang ara ira gare ro, “Leba omiuluan ties tung, tie eba mimi ba lop tuam o usingnualap migat.
Ga eba omira ties migat. Ga ties migat leba mikosarieng ga eba uakap ba ira mi.”
Pa mepulo tiesang gare ro, “Pava eap am Abraham. Karuk kan a tara ba la ponama ga okosarpang ubi agarit ang non migana. Memani ga tiesnung, ‘Eba betming ga uakap ba ira mi?’”
Ugama Iesu maime, “Mirulo migat. Mirier teip ga magaulap ganam la mime okosar kirinim, parepmeng uvat uriro kirinim maiong.
Migana o ubi la tale kan ume unama busit na luguan ang Ila Kani, Karuk. Pa Poi ang it irie la ume unama busit ana.
Are ratmat ga Poi ang la eba mikosarang ga uakap ba ira mi, uakap ara ira mi migat.
Mirit mimi eap am Abraham. Pa miga tominamung ga taving, memani, tiestung la tale kan iot na dalap mi.
Tume ties ma pagap la magimarung aun Mamo ruang. Pa mimi la mime makosar tavukup la mime miaram aun mamo ming kan.”
Mepulo tiesang Iesu, “Ira pang a Abraham.” Pa maulo Iesu, “Leba mimi ba lop am Abraham migat, tie eba makosarming mirier ubiap la makosarong Abraham.
Mirulo ma mirie tiesiap ganam o migat la tuptam aun Morowa. Pa titot la miga tominamung ga taving. Tale kan okosarong Abraham gare tiro.
Eva, akosarming migat tavuk ang mamo ming.” Teip mila uke la amelo Iesu, “Nagap pam la tale kan okoratmeng magi ga pamaiat. Pamaning it narit Mamo. Irie Morowa!”
Ugama Iesu maime, “La migat Morowa irie ira ming, eba tobomiving. Muana la tunama ga Morowa ga muruo. Tale kan muruo iro agat kan tung. Karuk. Morowa la tosagaong ga muruo.
Memani ga tale betieng tiestung la uakap na agarip mim? Muana a iriro la are ro. Tale kan puoming meba miptang ties tung. Kigip ma muranap mi la libonmeng ara.

Mimi lop am mamo ming, Satan. Are ratmat ga mitara mimamaranim la man omiuluo agat ang irie mamo ming. Tiralo kan irie migana la ume unamuam inamaniap ga mevara. Ga ume auluan tavuk o kakarabunim. Memani, tavuk o ties migat la tale kan iot na dalap a. Karuk. Tara la ume uaramo ties o kakarabunim urie tiesang la migat. Memani, irier migana o kakarabunim ga ira iang migat tavuk o ties o kakarabunim.
Are ratmat ga tale kan naganming ira ruo na tara la tume tuaramo ties migat.
Agat ming miga okosartung kirinim, a? Leba agatming gare rie, tie tomiabung na ties me iriro paga. Pa leba taramang ties migat, memani ga tale naganming ira ruo?
Lop am Morowa mirie la mime meptam mirier tiesiap am Morowa. Tale kan mimi lop am Morowa. Are ratmat ga tale kan mime mipto ties tung.”
Abraham la tale ka betong pa turuo la tunamar
Tie, Iudaiap la mepulo ties ang, “Ties pang migat noi. Nunuo migana onim Samaria ga non muranama ila kire la ut ira nuo.”
Pa upulo Iesu uriro ties gare ro, “Karuk kan a muranama ba ila kire la ut ira ruo. Karuk kan. Tuavio bonim a Mamo ruang, pa mime obomionama bonim tuo.
Tale kan tuavio bonim tuo kan. Pa non kan migana la man uavio bonim tuo, irie leba mavuvuoang teip ga magaulap la maialam ibup ma ira ruo.
Mirulo migat, ‘Man migana la ouluan ties tung, tala kan uvara. Karuk kan!’”
Megama Iudaiap aime, “Titot la nopetara, maning muranama ila kire la ut ira nuo. Abraham la uvara ra ga unulip la mevara ra. Pa nugama, “Man migana la ouluan maset ties tung, tala kan mevara.”
Atabo akurupnin ea buang Abraham, a? Uvara ra Abraham ga unulip gat. Agatnung la nuga aga, a?”
Tie, Iesu la upulo ties gare ro, “Leba taving kan bonim tuo me nakap, bonim tuo ula kakanu leba karuk ba a muana o. Pa Mamo ruang kan irie la uavio bonim tuo. Pa mime migama, irie Morowa buang.
Pa tale amit. Turuo la arit. La tugama, ‘Tale arit’, eba betang gare ba migana o kakarabunim gare mimi. Pa turuo la arit ara ga oruluan maset ties ang.
Ira ming, Abraham la teuba maset la namo ogimaang la rung. Eva, ogimaong ara ga temeba dalap a maset.”
Are ratmat ga amelo Iudaiap, “Kuot? Tale ka manim 50 ma karaip pa tiesnung, ‘Nugama agimanung Abraham!’”
Iesu la maulo, “Mirulo migat: Naga la tale ka iaria Abraham lake ra tunama.”
Iesu la tiesong gare tiro pa teip mila kakanim la maiaram tadasip meba abalemeng Iesu ga menamung. Pa kagouri Iesu ga aulai luguan o lotu ga ula lavie.
